subject: Orbit onramp sweetener — eligibility checklist & ops timeline
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha@orbitlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onramp support / startup sweetener for StartupOne pilot

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Orbit Labs is excited by the latency numbers and the idea of moving the proof-of-concept to a limited pilot. Two quick asks as we prep internal approval: 

1) Do you offer an onboarding "sweetener" (one-time free credits or stipend) for early-stage pilots? Our CFO likes to see a clear cost floor for the first 90 days.
2) If so, what are the eligibility criteria and how does that map to contract start/activation and invoicing? We need to know if the MOU needs to be signed before credits are applied or if credits can be granted retroactively after the pilot start date.

I've attached a short deck that outlines the StartupOne package we plan to run. Goal is a 6-week pilot starting 2026-09-07 if legal and procurement can align.

Appreciate a quick outline so I can build it into our procurement checklist.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Platforms — Orbit Labs
Attachments: Orbit_Onramp_StartupOne_presentation.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@orbitlabs.com>
Cc: Rick Gomez <rick@orbitlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp support / startup sweetener for StartupOne pilot

Hi Samantha — great to hear, and glad the demo resonated. Short answers up front: 

- Yes, we can provide a one-time onboarding stipend (standard is a credit pool applied to hosted usage).
- Eligibility: early-stage startups/incubators that haven't converted to a committed Dedicated contract and that commit to an active pilot with a designated product owner + weekly checkpoints.
- Credits are usually applied on activation (when the trial org is created and first API keys are used). We can consider retroactive application if procurement sign-off creates delay, but that requires an MOU/digital acknowledgment and ops confirmation.

I'll loop in our billing and legal ops folks to confirm the exact activation and invoicing flow and flag any limits on combining this with other promotional discounts. Proposed next step: I can send over a short mutual action plan (MAP) and an MOU template for Orbit to review — if you can confirm the pilot start window (you mentioned Sept 7) we'll try to align.

-Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — helping teams run inference in production

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Orbit Labs — request for onboarding stipend / retroactive credit consideration

Ben / Laura,

Orbit Labs (StartupOne) is planning a 6-week pilot, target kickoff 2026-09-07. Customer asked whether we can provide a one-time onboarding sweetener — either credits applied at activation or retroactively if procurement delays signing. They want clarity on whether the MOU must be signed before credits are applied.

Context: Orbit is mid-seed, annual projected spend low (pilot-sized), good technical fit for our hosted offering, and strategic as a reference in fintech infra. I'd like to offer a modest stipend (we typically do $5k–$10k equivalent credits for these pilots) but want to understand:

- Ops: can billing apply credits retroactively if we receive an MOU within 30 days of start? Any systems/ledger constraints?
- Legal: does giving credits before a signed MOU create risk we can't accept? Is a short MOU or purchase order acknowledgement enough?
- Commercial: if we offer the stipend, are we able to restrict combination with other promotional discounts or make it conditional on pilot completion and a feedback session?

Suggested approach: propose $7,500 credits applied at activation; if procurement delays >14 days, allow retroactive application only with an executed MOU and a signed MAP. Also propose a requirement of a weekly 30-min check-in and a brief 1-page feedback survey at the end.

Can you advise quickly? Orbit hopes to finalize approvals by EOD Friday.

Thanks — Karthik

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit Labs — request for onboarding stipend / retroactive credit consideration

Karthik — good call. My take:

1) Dollar band: $7.5k is within our standard sweetener range for seed-stage pilots; ok from a territory credit budget perspective.
2) Retroactive credits: Billing can apply a credit retroactively but we need a paper trail and a cost-authorization ticket. Ops prefers the MOU signed first but will accept retroactive credit if the MOU is executed within 30 days of pilot commencement and we get legal sign-off.
3) Restrictions: we should make the stipend non-stackable with other public promotions and require a signed MAP + a one-page post-pilot ROI summary. Also add a clause that credits expire 180 days after issue if unused.

Ask LA to confirm: what does ops need for the ledger entry and which internal code should we attach (funding source: Partnership Promo Q3)?

—Ben
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 14:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit Labs — request for onboarding stipend / retroactive credit consideration

Confirming ops side:

- We can post a retroactive credit (journal entry) provided we receive a signed MOU or PO referencing the Deal ID and an authorization from Sales (ties to Ben's note). Ticketing: open a Billing Ops ticket referencing DEAL-2026-ORB-1147 and attach the executed document.
- Internal GL/cost center: use code PROMO-PARTNERS-Q3-2026 for budget tracking. I'll create the budget reservation today so it doesn't get double-booked.
- Expiry & controls: set credit expiry to 180 days. We'll also mark the credits as non-transferable and non-stackable in the ledger notes.

If legal needs a shorter MOU template for quick sign, I can attach a one-page acceptance stub to the bill request.

Thanks — LA
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha@orbitlabs.com>
Cc: Rick Gomez <rick@orbitlabs.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp support / startup sweetener for StartupOne pilot

Hi Samantha — quick update and proposed MAP below. Thanks for the deck — looks like a clean pilot. Proposed terms we can commit to now: 

- Onboarding stipend: $7,500 in hosted credits applied to your org upon activation. Credits expire 180 days from issuance and are non-transferable.
- Eligibility: pilot must be run by StartupOne team, not already on Dedicated or other committed plan.
- Activation timing: credits applied at org activation. If procurement delays activation, we will accept retroactive credit application provided Orbit executes and returns the attached one-page MOU within 30 days of the pilot start and attaches Deal ID DEAL-2026-ORB-1147.
- Conditions: stipend is not combinable with other Redwood public promotions. Pilot includes weekly 30-min check-ins (sales + engineering) and a 1-page post-pilot ROI summary shared with Redwood.

Next steps (mutual action plan):
1) I attach a one-page MOU and a short MAP (one page) for Orbit to sign/acknowledge.
2) Orbit confirms pilot org name and a point of contact for weekly check-ins.
3) Redwood creates budget reservation and will provision credits on activation (or retroactively if MOU returned within 30 days).

Attachments: MOU_draft_v1.docx (one-page stub), MAP_StartUpOne_v1.pdf

If you’re good with this flow, I can send the MOU and MAP as DocuSign links today. Keen to get you into a pilot starting Tue 2026-09-07.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Onramp support / startup sweetener for StartupOne pilot — follow-up on Sam's questions

Sam — quick replies inline: 

- Expiry extension: we can consider extending to 270 days for strategic pilots with explicit runway evidence; please add a short note in the MOU under the "special terms" section and we’ll route for final approval (Ben will own the commercial sign-off).
- Restricting credits to the pilot org: yes, Billing Ops can tag the credits to a specific org ID and set API key scoping. LA noted we need the org name and the Deal ID on the ticket.

I’ll send the DocuSign links with the MOU that includes the special terms field; if Orbit wants the 270-day expiry we can include that as an optional checkbox pre-approved by Ben.

-Karthik
